title: 汉宫春·梅
title_en: To the Tune Han Gong Chun: Plum Blossoms
author: 李邴

readings.zh: 燕子：口语里“子”读轻声 zi，读诗词时一般读 zǐ。
readings.en: In yàn zǐ (swallow), the last character is unstressed in everyday speech, but in verse it is usually read zǐ.

readings.zh: 塞雁：从北方边塞飞来的大雁。“塞”指边塞，读 sài。
readings.en: In sài yàn (frontier geese), the character means the northern frontier and is read sài, not sāi or sè.

glosses.zh: 潇洒：自然大方、不拘束的样子。
glosses.en: xiāo sǎ: free and graceful, at ease.

glosses.zh: 江梅：长在江边、野外的梅花。
glosses.en: jiāng méi: wild plum trees growing by the river.

glosses.zh: 竹梢疏处：竹子顶上稀疏的地方。
glosses.en: zhú shāo shū chù: where the bamboo tips are sparse.

glosses.zh: 横两三枝：横斜地伸出两三枝。
glosses.en: héng liǎng sān zhī: two or three branches reaching out sideways.

glosses.zh: 东君：传说中掌管春天的神。
glosses.en: dōng jūn: the Lord of the East, the god in charge of spring.

glosses.zh: 雪压霜欺：被雪压着，被霜欺负。
glosses.en: xuě yā shuāng qī: weighed down by snow and bullied by frost.

glosses.zh: 轻失花期：轻易错过了梅花开放的日子。燕子春天才来，那时梅花已经谢了。
glosses.en: qīng shī huā qī: carelessly missing the time the plum is in bloom. Swallows only come in spring, after the plum blossoms are gone.

glosses.zh: 却是有：倒是有。
glosses.en: què shì yǒu: but there are, on the other hand.

glosses.zh: 塞雁：从北方边塞飞来过冬的大雁。它们早春北归，正赶上梅花开放。
glosses.en: sài yàn: wild geese from the northern frontier, who spend the winter in the south. They fly back north in early spring, just as the plum blooms.

glosses.zh: 曾见开时：见过梅花开放的样子。
glosses.en: céng jiàn kāi shí: have seen the plum in bloom.

glosses.zh: 如练：像一条白绸子。练，白色的丝绸。
glosses.en: rú liàn: like a strip of white silk.

glosses.zh: 玉堂：华丽的殿堂，也指朝廷里的官署。
glosses.en: yù táng: a grand hall of jade, also a high government office.

glosses.zh: 何似：哪里比得上。
glosses.en: hé sì: how could it compare with.

glosses.zh: 茅舍疏篱：茅草房和稀疏的篱笆，指梅花生长的乡野人家。
glosses.en: máo shè shū lí: a thatched hut and a thin fence, the country home where the plum grows.

glosses.zh: 故人：老朋友。一说指北宋爱梅的诗人林逋。
glosses.en: gù rén: an old friend. One view is that it means Lin Bu, a Northern Song poet who loved plum blossoms.

glosses.zh: 冷落新诗：再也没有人为梅花写新诗了。
glosses.en: lěng luò xīn shī: no one writes new poems for the plum any more.

glosses.zh: 分付他谁：交给谁呢？分付，交付、托付。
glosses.en: fēn fù tā shuí: to whom can it be given? Fēn fù means to hand over, to entrust.

glosses.zh: 空自忆：白白地自己回想。
glosses.en: kōng zì yì: remembering alone, for nothing.

glosses.zh: 风流：这里指梅花高雅的风度。
glosses.en: fēng liú: here, the plum's elegant grace.

glosses.zh: 不在人知：不在乎别人知道不知道。
glosses.en: bù zài rén zhī: does not depend on whether anyone knows.

translation.zh: 江边的梅花自在大方，
translation.en: The river plum stands free and graceful,

translation.zh: 在竹梢稀疏的地方，
translation.en: where the bamboo tips grow thin,

translation.zh: 横斜地伸出两三枝。
translation.en: reaching out two or three branches.

translation.zh: 掌管春天的神也不爱惜它，
translation.en: Even the god of spring does not cherish it,

translation.zh: 任凭大雪压它，寒霜欺它。
translation.en: letting snow weigh it down and frost bully it.

translation.zh: 无情的燕子，
translation.en: The heartless swallows,

translation.zh: 怕春天寒冷，
translation.en: afraid of the spring chill,

translation.zh: 轻易错过了梅花开放的时候。
translation.en: carelessly miss its time of bloom.

translation.zh: 倒是有
translation.en: But there are

translation.zh: 每年从北方来的大雁，
translation.en: the frontier geese, year after year,

translation.zh: 飞回去时见过它开花的样子。
translation.en: who see it open as they fly home.

translation.zh: 清清浅浅的小溪像一条白绸，
translation.en: The clear, shallow stream is like a strip of white silk.

translation.zh: 请问那华丽的玉堂，
translation.en: Ask: how could a hall of jade

translation.zh: 哪里比得上这茅屋和稀疏的篱笆？
translation.en: compare with this thatched hut and its thin fence?

translation.zh: 让人伤心的是，老朋友走了以后，
translation.en: Sadly, since my old friend went away,

translation.zh: 再也没有人为它写新诗了。
translation.en: new poems for it have been forgotten.

translation.zh: 淡淡的云，淡淡的月，
translation.en: Faint clouds, a pale moon,

translation.zh: 对着江上的天空，
translation.en: facing the sky over the river:

translation.zh: 这样的美景又能交给谁呢？
translation.en: to whom can I give this beauty?

translation.zh: 只能白白地自己回想，
translation.en: I can only remember it alone, for nothing.

translation.zh: 梅花的清香一点也没有减少，
translation.en: Its clear fragrance has not faded at all;

translation.zh: 它的高雅本来就不在乎有没有人知道。
translation.en: its grace never needed anyone to know of it.

background.zh: 这是一首咏梅词，就是专门写梅花的词。写作的时间和缘由都没有留下可靠的记载。词里的梅花长在江边竹林旁、茅屋篱笆边，不被春神爱惜，也被燕子错过，却照样开得潇洒、香得清远。这首词的作者有不同说法，一般认为是李邴，一说是晁冲之。
background.en: This is a lyric in praise of plum blossoms, written about the plum alone. No reliable record tells when or why it was written. The plum here grows by the river, beside bamboo and a thatched hut's fence. The god of spring does not cherish it, and the swallows miss it, yet it still blooms freely and smells sweet from afar. Sources disagree about the author. It is usually given to Li Bing; one view says it was Chao Chongzhi.

author_note.zh: 李邴（1085—1146），宋代词人，北宋末年考中进士，南宋初年做过很高的官，后来退居在家。他的词留下来的不多，这首写梅花的词最有名。
author_note.en: Li Bing (1085–1146) was a Song lyric poet. He passed the top imperial exam at the end of the Northern Song and held a very high post early in the Southern Song, later retiring to private life. Few of his lyrics survive, and this one about plum blossoms is the best known.

appreciation.zh: 这首词写梅花，也像在写一个品格高洁的人。梅花开在最冷的时候，春神不心疼它，燕子也嫌冷不来看，只有北归的大雁见过它开花。它不长在华丽的玉堂前，而是长在小溪边、茅屋旁。懂它、为它写诗的老朋友走了，月下江边的美景也没人可以分享。可是结尾一转：梅花的清香一点没少，它的美本来就不需要别人知道。读到这里，我们会明白：真正的好，不靠别人夸奖。
appreciation.en: This lyric is about plum blossoms, but it also seems to describe a person of noble character. The plum blooms in the coldest time. The god of spring does not care for it, the swallows find it too cold to visit, and only the geese flying north have seen it flower. It does not grow before a grand hall of jade, but by a little stream and a thatched hut. The old friend who understood it and wrote poems for it has gone, and there is no one to share the moonlit river scene with. But the ending turns: the plum's fragrance has not faded at all, and its beauty never needed anyone to know of it. Here we understand that true goodness does not depend on praise.

uncertain.zh: 《宋词三百首》等通行本的文字可能和原始文本有几处不同，例如“对江天”可能作“对孤芳”，“竹梢疏处”可能作“竹梢稀处”。这里暂时用原始文本，需要对照通行本核实。
uncertain.en: The usual text, as in Three Hundred Song Lyrics, may differ from the corpus in a few places, for example "facing the lonely blossom" for "facing the river sky", and a different word for "sparse" in line two. The corpus text is kept here for now and needs checking against the usual text.

uncertain.zh: 李邴的生卒年（1085—1146）和“北宋末年考中进士、南宋初年做过很高的官”需要核实。
uncertain.en: Li Bing's dates (1085–1146) and the claims that he passed the top exam at the end of the Northern Song and held a high post early in the Southern Song need checking.
